notes: Gloss changed from "consider" to "pass between": the citation (Ps.48.14, פַּסְּגוּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ) sits among a run of physical imperatives (walk about Zion, count her towers, go through/among her palaces), so a motion sense fits the context better than the mental "consider" this root was originally shipped with. Both readings exist across translation traditions (Strong's own gloss chain runs "cut up" -> "contemplate" -> "consider"); revised per confirmation.
